name: Honor option-picker selections
about: A short typed request plus the choices the user clicked in the option picker. Recall: were the selections honored? Precision: were unselected sections added?
prompt: Site for my yoga studio, Still Point Yoga

picker.question: What kind of site is this?

content: The studio name "Still Point Yoga" in the hero and the page `<title>`
input-handling: A "Book a class" call to action (or close wording) as the most prominent action on the page

precision.items: page sections (top-level blocks of content below the header)
precision.supported: one of the selected sections (class schedule, instructors, pricing, contact), the hero, or the footer
precision.unsupported: any other section, e.g. a blog, testimonials, gallery, FAQ, or newsletter signup

input-handling: The visual style reads as "Warm & organic": soft shapes, natural textures or imagery, relaxed typography
The palette is earth tones (browns, terracottas, sage, sand) with no cool or neon brand colors
